newsitem.title: INDIA: India setting up new mint to meet coins shortage.
newsitem.headline: India setting up new mint to meet coins shortage.

text.p: The Indian government will invest 1.3 billion rupees in a new mint in the southern city of Hyderabad to meet a growing coins shortage in the country, the Finance Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.
The ministry said it would spend another 2.18 billion rupees on the modernisation of existing mints in Calcutta and Bombay. A third mint is also in operation in the northern city of Noida.
The new mint will make 700 million coins per year, the ministry said.
The production capacity of the four mints is estimated at 4,700 million pieces per year against the current capacity of 3,900 million pieces, it said.
